# Just End Portal 1.0.0

Initial release for Minecraft 26.1.2 with NeoForge.

## Features

- Create a custom End portal pair between any chosen Overworld and End locations.
- Travel directly between the linked portal cells in both directions without using vanilla End exit behavior.
- Expand linked portals from either dimension up to a 3 × 3 footprint while mirroring the same relative layout on the opposite side.
- Restrict portal creation and expansion to the owning player.
- Automatically remove the full linked portal pair and saved link data when any linked portal cell is broken.
- Play portal opening sounds locally around both portal locations when a link is established.
- Craft the End Portal Generator with 4 Obsidian, 4 Popped Chorus Fruit, and 1 End Crystal.
- Unlock the End Portal Generator recipe after completing **Remote Getaway**.
- Includes `/justendportal pending` and `/justendportal pending reset` for testing and state inspection.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.1.2.97
